test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which ministry of Government of India has published Goods and Service Tax (GST) Act, 2017?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Law and Justice.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Law and Justice**. Goods and Services Tax (GST) is an indirect tax used in India on the manufacture, sale, and consumption of goods and services in India. 
 
• The Goods and Service Tax (GST) Act, 2017 was published by** the Ministry of Law and Justice.**
 
• **Telangana was the first amongst states** to pass the Act on April 9 followed by Bihar on April 24. **Karnataka passed the bill on June 15. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****
